disease_label_per_paper: T12-L5 spinal epidural abscess with left paravertebral extension after acute pyelonephritis
presentation_summary: 54-year-old woman had previously been hospitalized with acute pyelonephritis for 3 weeks and was readmitted about one week later.
She presented with persistent lumbar pain, visual analog score 8/10, and new spastic paraparesis graded 4/5 without sphincter dysfunction.
Lumbar CT showed left paravertebral and epidural collections from T12 to L5.
Lumbosacral MRI showed a T12-L5 anterior epidural hypointense ring-enhancing lesion, maximum AP diameter 1.2 cm at L2-L3, causing severe cauda equina compression.
She underwent L2-L4 decompressive laminectomy with drainage of intraspinal/extradural and paravertebral SEA; Staphylococcus aureus was isolated from surgery.
